title: XML Validation against xsd
content:
1.	Upload Your XML File
	•	Click the 'Choose File' button (labeled as 'Choose File' in some browsers).
	•	Select your .xml file from your computer.
2.	Start Validation
	•	After selecting your file, click the 'Validate XML' button.
3.	View the Results
	•	If the XML is valid, you will see a green box with the message 'XML is valid'.
	•	If there are validation errors, you will see an orange box listing the errors.
	•	The content of your XML file will also be displayed below for reference.
4.	Error Handling
	•	If you try to validate without uploading a file, an error message will appear.
	•	Any other errors during validation will also be shown on the page.

title: Signing explanation
content:
To sign an XML file using this page, follow these steps:

1.	Upload the XML File
	•	Click the 'Upload XML file' button.
	•	Select the XML file you want to sign from your computer.
2.	Upload the Certificate (.pfx) File
	•	Click the 'Certificate (.pfx)' button.
	•	Select your certificate file (with a .pfx extension).
3.	Enter the Password
	•	In the 'Password' field, enter the password for your certificate.
	•	You can click the eye icon to show or hide the password as you type.
4.	Sign the XML
	•	If the uploaded XML does not already contain a signature, a 'Sign XML' button will appear.
	•	Click 'Sign XML' to start the signing process.
5.	Download the Signed XML
	•	After signing, the signed XML will be displayed on the page.
	•	Click the 'Download XML' button to save the signed file to your computer.

Notes:
	•	If the XML already contains a signature, you will see a message indicating this and the signing option will be disabled.
	•	Any errors (such as missing files or incorrect password) will be shown below the form.

title: Download IVI
content:
To download an IVI (Initial Vehicle Information) file using this page, follow these steps:
1.	Click the Download Button labeled 'Download IVI 2.0 XSD'
2.	Check the Status Message:
	• If the download is successful, a message 'Download successful!' will appear.
	• If the download fails, a message 'Download failed. Please try again.' will appear.

content:
